1.recordBindings: counts + jobs + standards + disjoint run/downtime intervals
1.aggregation: Pool planned/run/ideal-total/ideal-good times. Count-quality pools unique counts. Homogeneous A*P*countQ matches ideal-good/planned; mixed cycle scope requires declared time-weightedQ as separate definition.

2.grain: job output matched to frozen plan/capacity segment
2.recordBindings: counts + jobs + schedules + governed capacity calendar
2.aggregation: Sum nonduplicated compatible quantities; rates sum eligible output/exposure. Plant exposure is asset-time for operating rates; calendar throughput denominator must be explicitly plant elapsed vs asset-hour, not interchanged.

3.aggregation: Quantity-attainment and scheduled-date order count are separate. Scope due cohort at as_of; preserve original plan version and defined tolerance.

4.grain: unique unit/lot route boundary and operation segment
4.recordBindings: lots + quality_stages + standards + jobs + explicit queue/setup/move timestamps
4.aggregation: Elapsed lead time as distribution; mean across completed eligible lots with stated weighting. Touch is interval union, not parallel person-hours.

5.grain: asset stop interval clipped to included planned time
5.aggregation: Union overlapping same-asset intervals; assign one governed reason per segment; simultaneous independent assets pool asset-minutes. Never sum line and machine copies.

6.aggregation: Transition elapsed durations pooled by transition count; internal/external task union independently, no parallel labor double count.

7.grain: unique inspected/produced/shipped unit cohort with terminal disposition
7.aggregation: Defective unit once, defects can exceed units; final good and FPY distinct; rework remains excluded from firstpass numerator; source specimen/inspection sampling cannot silently become produced-unit denominator.

8.grain: same initial route cohort and ordered stage
8.aggregation: Product eligible stage firstpass yields at full precision; pool stage numerators/denominators across eligible comparable lots before product, not average lot RTY.

9.grain: characteristic/spec revision rational subgroup and raw measurements
9.aggregation: Reestimate mean,within/overall sigma from raw data; no averaging Cp/Cpk. Approved estimator and rational subgroup required. Measurement units converted consistently before limit comparisons.

10.grain: functional failure incident and operating exposure/repair segment
10.aggregation: Operating-hours/failures ratio for descriptive MTBF; active repair elapsed distinct from restore elapsed and person-hours. Include right-censored exposure. Inferential lifetime models need separate fit and uncertainty; no average asset MTBF.

11.grain: customer order, explicitly order-line if selected
11.aggregation: Order OTIF conjunct over ALL its eligible lines; join shipments aggregate quantities before counting each order. Due cohort includes open orders, OTD delivered cohort distinct.

12.grain: item-location balance interval and matching consumption ledger period
12.aggregation: Balances snapshot or time-weighted integral; never sum day snapshots. Opening/closing average only named demo convention. Same currency/unit/window. Annual turns distinct from period turns.

13.recordBindings: time-weighted WIP + throughput exit events + lead-time cohort
13.aggregation: A dimensional identity under stable boundary/steady state; not causal model. WIP units / units-per-day yields days. Do not divide inventory currency by throughput units.

14.aggregation: Sum person-hours, not elapsed asset-hours; same good-output cohort. Product standards contribute sum(qty*standard hours), no averaging product standards.

15.grain: exclusive cost transaction/version by period and accepted output
15.recordBindings: cost_rates + cost ledger + counts + labor/material events
15.aggregation: Sum costs one currency and basis; per-unit pool cost/output. Absolute vs normalized variance separate. Downtime estimate not additive to ledger actuals without approved valuation.

16.aggregation: Scrap/rework detail included in internal failure total, not added twice; warranty subset external. Currency comparisons cannot infer realized savings.

17.recordBindings: meter_readings + daily_energy + demand_intervals + output + versioned factor
17.aggregation: Energy from non-reset meter deltas. kW interval max distinct from kWh. Scope output to same meter boundary; idle classification defined, factor kgCO2e/kWh version. Gaps/resets withheld.

18.aggregation: Run utilization distinct from productive utilization. Units/time good output; throughput-contribution financial model not operational quantity.

19.grain: classified incident and eligible worker exposure period
19.aggregation: Recordable/DART/lost-time case IDs deduplicated; multiplier200000 matches worked personhours; no inference zero risk from zero observed incidents.

20.grain: versioned metric/target policy for selected scope
20.recordBindings: metric definitions + target versions + same result
20.aggregation: Illustrative source thresholds85%OEE etc are reference examples, not Northworks80%target. Govern interval ranges and direction.

21.aggregation: Additive time waterfall planned-run-(ideal total loss)-(ideal good loss)=ideal good; unit bridge separately uses compatible rates. Favorable signed gaps retained, positive-only ranking presentation.

22.aggregation: Recompute both operands; percent ratios retain fraction internally and pp display; relative needs nonzero prior; target version frozen.

23.aggregation: Moving-average length/grain explicit; OLS uses numeric time offsets, sample SD n>=2 proposed; missing/stale points not silently interpolated. Temporal leakage prohibited.

24.aggregation: Rank by value descending then stable categoryID tie; cumulative numerator/uncapped total. Nine categories retained; topN plus Other explicit.

25.grain: case baseline/post eligible windows and due-action cohort
25.aggregation: Signed change not favorable direction; before/after matching and coverage; due-action numerator must be subset due denominator. Closure never proves performed/verified. Missing breaks sustain streak.

26.aggregation: Non-scalar fields require schema validation, owners/effectivity/provenance, not fake metrics.

27.recordBindings: canonical results + attributed notes + knowledge + approval
27.aggregation: Measured facts, derived observations and hypotheses distinct; no computational root-cause proof from similarity.

28.aggregation: Clarify conflicting meanings; retain source occurrence trace; library listing is recognition not execution/certification.
